text:
:= by
intro h
split
· intro s a ha
  have : Finset.cons a s ha = s ∪ {a} := by rfl
  rw [Finset.union_eq_self_or_disjoint, Finset.disjoint_singleton_left_iff]
  exact h s (Finset.singleton_subset_iff.1 (Finset.disjoint_iff.2 ha))
· intro h'
  intros s a ha
  have : Finset.cons a s ha = s ∪ {a} := by rfl
  rw [Finset.union_eq_self_or_disjoint, Finset.disjoint_singleton_left_iff]
  exact h' s (Finset.singleton_subset_iff.1 (Finset.disjoint_iff.2 ha))
